blind.table_distance_name: charnel trough with bones and skulls
blind.description: A rectangular carved dark grey stone trough or low ossuary basin filled to overflowing with human skulls and long bones. The stone container features paneled side reliefs and squared corner pilasters/feet resting directly on the ground. The bones and skulls inside are piled haphazardly with a weathered bone-tan/light-brown coloration and sculpted anatomical details like eye sockets, craniums, and femurs. Surfaces are solid and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or disconnected geometry.
blind.from_above: A long rectangular dark stone rim framing an interior pile of clustered human skulls and crossing long bones.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.5 ft tall); length is around 4 to 4.5 feet, width around 1.5 to 2 feet.
